# MisterLibrarian

> A fresh translation of the Bible into modern English, made one chapter at a time from the
> original Hebrew (the Masoretic Text) and Greek (SBLGNT), with the source text reproduced
> verse-by-verse and translator's notes comparing every rendering choice against a fixed shelf
> of seven landmark versions (NIV 2011, KJV, Douay-Rheims, The Living Bible, the 1599 Geneva
> Bible, the ASV, and the NWT 1984). Published alongside five smaller sourced blogs under the
> same "Mr. Librarian" persona, all reachable from the home page hub.

Every translation choice is footnoted against the seven-version shelf rather than asserted;
where a shelf version differs for doctrinal (not factual) reasons, that's flagged as such. Full
Table of Contents and translation doctrine: https://mistertranslation.com/bible.html

## Bible translation

- [Table of Contents](https://mistertranslation.com/bible.html): every translated chapter, English and Spanish, with progress tracked by book
- [Dictionary](https://mistertranslation.com/dictionary.html): per-term entries for names, places and concepts referenced in the translation
- [Encyclopedia](https://mistertranslation.com/encyclopedia.html): background entries on people, events and customs
- [Atlas](https://mistertranslation.com/atlas.html): place entries with historical/geographic context
- [Dear Mr. Librarian](https://mistertranslation.com/ask/): reader questions about the text, answered from the same sourcing standard

## Other publications (same author, same sourcing discipline)

- [The Librarian's Ledger](https://mistertranslation.com/finance/): finance & markets blog, cites primary sources, states "where I could be wrong"
- [The Librarian Abroad](https://mistertranslation.com/travel/): travel & food blog
- [The Librarian's Regimen](https://mistertranslation.com/health/): health & nutrition, read from primary literature, never medical advice
- [The Librarian's Notebook](https://mistertranslation.com/notebook/): science/tech, world affairs and arts, general-interest
- [Eight Miles West](https://mistertranslation.com/west/): a family history published as numbered chapters, in order

## Notes for automated readers

- Spanish editions of the Bible pages exist at the same path with a `.es.html` suffix; both
  are listed with reciprocal hreflang in /sitemap.xml.
- Per-verse `/v/*.html` stub pages exist for link previews and are intentionally noindex; cite
  the chapter page they canonicalize to instead.
- Full sitemaps: /sitemap.xml (Bible), /travel/sitemap.xml, /finance/sitemap.xml,
  /health/sitemap.xml, /notebook/sitemap.xml, /west/sitemap.xml, /ask/sitemap.xml
